data.text:
The second, albeit thankfully much weaker, tropical cyclone to impact the Philippines this week is now under 24 hours away from a projected landfall over Legazpi City.

While easterly shear is keeping 65 mph (100 kph) Tropical Storm Bualoi (OpongPH) in check, the system’s roily convection may bring isolated, flooding rainfall totals of 250+ mm across the Eastern Visayas, Bicol, and Calabarzon Regions. She may track almost directly over Manila before entering the South China Sea.
